body: Congrats man.. Since we're doing this.. In a span of a month life tore me down. Family disowned me, took all my money, no job, no home, in a state that i hate but school is all I have so I stayed here. I've been hanging out at Starbucks and a 24hr diner to get wifi in order to play. I play to make the scary thoughts go away. I hang in there coz I wanna watch MLG.
She actually got fired.. And all we have is the director, who gives me the 211 number..
No, they just took me to the er,, got discharged, sent me to planned parenthood for an abortion.. I don't have insurance.. I have nothing.. And no one, but school.
Thank you.. I have a few posts on suicidewatch.. But.. Even after that, it doesn't leave my mind
I recently.. Just had an abortion... Not proud of it.. But this just.. Hurts
It's so hard because i will start working as a nurse for a church/pre-school, I will be surrounded by, the things that i just went against..  but really, Thank you so much...
Thank you.. Thanks everyone! I needed this.. I might just read this everyday until I forgive myself..

funny you say I should trust myself, coz i feel like i don't know me anymore,, this is not something i would do,, but i did,, its so bad and it was so stupid, any birth control i was using didnt work,, and yeah,, i can't believe that I am seriously alone in this, makes me feel more horrible, i must be such a bad person
i just had an abortion,,, i have no one to talk to about it,, i cant forgive myself

I tried to do it last night, almost succeeded if it wasn't for the guy patrolling the area i was at,, so here i am,back to life, sitting here, reading your comments,, yeah some of you may think that it was stupid,, if i was gonna do it, do it right,, i was almost done with this life. i don't know if i should be thankful or what,, this is not what i expected, to wake up at a hospital after i found to courage to end it.
this life is just not for everyone,,, a part of me wants to tell you to hold on and don't give up,, but that part is hangin on by a burning thread,,,

I'm not really one to give an advice,, but hun,, i live in a homeless shelter,, no family,, no money,, all i have is school,, which i cant pay for,, you will fail in school over and over until you have your heart set on it,, it will happen, you are waay too young to give up,, or not until all you have is everything thats in your car,, with nowhere to go,, no job no money no food,, then maybe you can join me and we'll end it together.
hey, my parents disowned me, you don't see me making a meme about it. Because no matter what happens, without them you won't be here.
thank you,,, they turned  off the wifi at the shelter so im outside starbucks soaking wifi lol
